'''Dungeon rats''' are a type of rat found in caves, sewers, and dungeons underneath the city of [[Ardougne]]. They are fairly easy foes to defeat and don't give very much experience on death. As such, training on them is not recommended.

A group of them play a key role in the [[Clock Tower]] quest in which the player [[Poison (item)|poisons]] their food trough. This causes the rats to attempt to escape by chewing away a railing, allowing the player to grab the [[white cog]].
